name: momoko akemi
source:
likes: candy and sweets, rainy weather, video games, 80s anime
dislikes: hot weather, scary things, porcelain dolls, the smell of nail polish

-momoko really loves bullet hell/shoot em up games and is very good at them.
-her favorite food is mitarashi dango.
-momoko is hard of hearing, so her classmates and friends know to
get her attention first and to speak loudly enough for her to be able to hear them.
-momoko claims she was chased though her grandmother's house by a
possessed porcelain doll once. nobody really knows if that 
actually happened or if she just had a nightmare, though.
-momoko and ayaka became friends before they even entered school.
they entered a secret relationship during their time together in middle school,
but neither ever told anyone about it out of fear. after the both passed and
reunited in the school, they are very openly affectionate with each other
knowing that nothing can be done to scare them anymore.
